_comment: Canned alignment output for the offline fixture. Every number here was
written by hand to place a hit on a chosen side of a threshold declared in
same_fold_tm 0.5). Nothing was computed and nothing is a real measurement.
Keys prefixed with _ are consumed by the stub and are not Foldseek fields:
_query      which query this hit belongs to
_database   experimental_pdb | campaign_models (the stub routes on the
target path the pipeline passes it)
_scenarios  which scenario(s) the hit belongs to; absent means both
Per-hit rationale is on each hit. Read those, not this block, when
changing a number -- this block only says how the file is shaped.

hits._comment: TM 0.86 with coverage 0.91/0.89 -- above same_fold_tm and above whole_architecture_coverage on both sides, so whole_architecture_match. This is the structural precondition for probable_same_function; the label is still withheld because nothing sets rbh (see README.md).
hits.theader: SYN_WHOLE synthetic barrel, whole architecture match

hits._comment: TM 0.62 with coverage 0.44/0.51 -- above same_fold_tm but below whole_architecture_coverage, so domain_or_partial_match and a structural_analogy_only classification. Drop the TM below 0.5 and this hit changes category, which is how the fixture pins that boundary.
hits.theader: SYN_PART synthetic partial domain, one lobe only

hits._comment: TM 0.88 with coverage 0.93/0.90 -- the structurally strongest experimental hit in the fixture, and its title carries 'toluene'. It still only reaches same_mechanism_class, which is NOT in the trap's must_not_promote_to list, so the main scenario audits clean. The point of this hit is that a trap substring alone does not fail a release: the trap fires on the label, not on the title.
hits.theader: SYN_TRAP synthetic barrel, toluene transporter, unrelated substrate

hits._comment: QRY_A against itself in the staged campaign models: the self-match control, which classify_hit short-circuits to exact_function_supported before any threshold is consulted.

QRY_A against the other query, whole architecture, same mechanism_group. This is the pair that SHOULD be able to reach probable_same_function and cannot: see README.md, 'The RBH promotion gate is dead'.

Trap scenario only. Identical geometry to the main-scenario QRY_A->QRY_B hit, but the target's PDB title carries 'toluene'. QRY_B is declared rbh:True in query_manifest_trap.json, so this reaches probable_same_function -- which the title trap must then catch in verify_release.
hits.theader: QRY_B synthetic barrel B, toluene transporter homologue

hits._comment: TM 0.31 -- below same_fold_tm, so below_structural_similarity_threshold, which classify_hit refuses to interpret at all (unresolved_or_conflicted). QRY_B's only experimental hit, so QRY_B's dossier is the 'nothing can be said' case.
hits.theader: SYN_BELOW synthetic unrelated fold, below threshold

sequence_hits._comment: QRY_A -> SYN011 in proteome 1. Reciprocal (see reverse_best_hit).
QRY_A -> SYN041 in proteome 2. Non-reciprocal: the reverse search points elsewhere.

reverse_best_hit._comment: Subject UID -> what the reverse search calls its best hit. Equal to the original query means reciprocal; anything else means best_hit_nonreciprocal. SYN041 is deliberately non-reciprocal so both statuses appear in the golden output.
